description: Verifies that PostgreSQL dialect accurately parses native PostgreSQL schemas, queries, and executes execution testing in PostgreSQL.
schema:
CREATE TABLE employees (emp_id INT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, department VARCHAR(50), salary NUMERIC(10, 2) CHECK (salary > 0));
CREATE TABLE projects (project_id INT PRIMARY KEY, title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, lead_id INT, FOREIGN KEY (lead_id) REFERENCES employees(emp_id) ON DELETE SET NULL);
correct_query: SELECT emp_id, name FROM employees WHERE salary > 50000

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT emp_id, name FROM employees WHERE salary < 50000
